care_benchmark.rule: weighted average of the four components
care_benchmark.definition: Guck, Roelofs and Faulstich, Data 2024, 9(12), 138; doi:10.3390/data9120138
care_benchmark.caveat: Our implementation of the published definition, computed on the events this project could assess. Not a score returned by the benchmark's own harness and not a leaderboard entry.

summary.caveat: Own normal-behavior approach evaluated on real CARE labels; not a published CARE benchmark score.
summary.threshold_selection: z cut-off calibrated per event on held-out normal training rows; no event labels used
summary.not_assessable_reason: turbine not in normal operation during the prediction window, so no early-detection signal exists to measure
